correctness_basis: RTLLM reference implementation (verified_*.v) for this task; must pass the RTLLM testbench unchanged at baseline.
baseline_edits: Module renamed verified_multi_pipe_8bit -> multi_pipe_8bit to match the testbench instantiation (RTLLM convention). No other change.
known_quirks: Upstream reset branch assigns mul_a_reg twice and never resets mul_b_reg; kept as-is (baseline is not repaired).

tb.test_inputs: testbench-internal $random with the simulator's default seed (no plusarg); 1 directed + 100 random vectors

regions.description: right-hand side of the non-reset assignment `mul_out_reg <= ...;` (line 80 of the original)
regions.kind: pure combinational expression feeding register mul_out_reg
regions.preconditions: operands sum[0..3] are reg [15:0] (unsigned), LHS mul_out_reg is reg [15:0]; expression is context-determined 16-bit, i.e. addition modulo 2^16; no intermediate truncation, extension, saturation or comparison

allowed_transform.definition: Regroup or reorder a same-width unsigned addition modulo 2^W: the replacement must be a sum of exactly the current region's operands (same multiset), combined only with binary + and parentheses.

negative_controls.intent: replace operand sum[3] with sum[2]: corrupts mul_out whenever partial products 6/7 are non-zero; TB must report failure
